hero.title: File:1916 Atlantic hurricane season summary map.png
hero.credit: Created by Supportstorm using Wikipedia:WikiProject Tropical cyclones/Tracks. The background image is from NASA [1]. The tracking data is from the National Hurricane Center's Atlantic hurricane database.
hero.description: This map shows the tracks of all tropical cyclones in the 1916 Atlantic hurricane season. The points show the location of each storm at 6-hour intervals. The colour represents the storm's maximum sustained wind speeds as classified in the Saffir-Simpson Hurricane Scale (see below), and the shape of the data points represent the type of the storm.
